delivery.ack: a short reply (at most 4 words) when the player does what the last cue asked; may play during a difficult moment, right after the cue
delivery.cue: at most 6 words, may play during a difficult moment, instruction only
delivery.curiosity: optional card, on request or when paused
delivery.leg: the story continued after a random 10-20 s of calm without talk, in order
delivery.reflection: plays right after a difficulty ends
delivery.story: plays in a calm stretch, the character's line for a beat
delivery.trivia: a fact about the boats, the region, the fish or the jobs, played after a random 10-20 s of calm without talk once the story has nothing left

events.when: mission starts
tack_side changes with the wind passing the bow
tack_side changes with the wind passing the stern
gybe with sheets at most 0.5 as the stern crosses
gybe with sheets above 0.5
point_of_sail in_irons and u < 0.5 m/s for 3 s
after enter_irons: abs(twa_deg) > 45 and u > 0.8 m/s
luffing_fraction > 0.5 for 5 s on a steady heading
luffing_fraction < 0.2 for 3 s after luffing_start
heel_ratio > 0.7
heel_ratio >= 1
true wind speed up 30 % within 5 s
true wind direction moves 10° within 5 s
point_of_sail band changes and holds 5 s
heading within 10° and point_of_sail unchanged for 20 s
another boat within 3 boat lengths or time_to_contact < 15 s
collision reported by the mission
aground flag set
aground flag cleared
distance_to_target under the mission's approach distance
mission goal reached (dock, mark, buoy rounded, alongside, catch)
15 s left on a timed task
time limit reached
mission over, any outcome
whale surfaces
within 22 m of the whale from astern
whale sees the boat and dives
whale dives after breathing, or mission ends
muleta switches to lateral fishing
fish caught over a shoal
within 35 m of the boat at anchor and under 1.5 kn
seaweed or rubbish picked up
the boat passes within a few hundred metres of a named place or landmark; the trigger names it, as near_place:<name>
sheets hauled in by at least 0.2 within 3 s
sheets eased by at least 0.2 within 3 s
trim error below 0.1 for 2 s after being above 0.25
turning towards the wind by at least 20° within 5 s
turning away from the wind by at least 20° within 5 s
